arStrings.szText: Each stack increases Falling Star's damage by {c_number}[SF_23 * 100|%x|]{/c}.
Killing a {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} enemy reduces the cooldown of {c_important}Falling Star{/c} by {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} second.
When landing, {c_important}Falling Star{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:LANDING_PAYLOAD_A}{/c} damage and erupts {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} additional times.

{c_important}Falling Star{/c} becomes a {c_important}Zealot{/c} skill, now dealing {c_number}{payload:LANDING_PAYLOAD_B}{/c} damage on landing and {c_important}{u}Weakening{/u}{/c} enemies hit for {c_number}[4]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Falling Star{/c} cuts through the battlefield, Knocking Down enemies for {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds when landing and creating a fissure along your path that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_MIDDLE_LINE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage before erupting for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_SIDE_LINE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Falling Star{/c} applies {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} to enemies for {c_number}[SF_32]{/c} seconds on landing.
Killing a {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} enemy reduces the Cooldown of {c_important}Falling Star{/c} by {c_number}[{SF_11}|1|]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Falling Star{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_37*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage if it is cast again within {c_number}[SF_36]{/c} seconds.
